# sprint views list

```text
NAME
  sprint views list — Search filters current access before counts and pagination. Views enforce personal ownership or linked native team membership. Subscription creation requires resource revision plus operation key; changes use subscription revision. Inbox state changes require its revision; snooze requires a future until timestamp. --all walks sequential pages.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint views list [--json-data OBJECT | --file PATH] [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Search filters current access before counts and pagination. Views enforce personal ownership or linked native team membership. Subscription creation requires resource revision plus operation key; changes use subscription revision. Inbox state changes require its revision; snooze requires a future until timestamp. --all walks sequential pages.

EXAMPLES
  sprint views list

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output data or records + meta on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  API action: productivity.listViews
```
